==Active Ability: Mind Control==
[[File:MindControlIcon.png|thumb|left]]
On his max upgrade, {{PAGENAME}} can make enemies within his range walk back for a couple of seconds. This includes bosses, which makes him a good support unit.  Stun/Freeze/Walkback/knockback and similar effects can't stack, and there is a 1s delay before an enemy can be affected again
* Duration: 5s
* Cooldown: 40s
* delay before another walkback can be used on the same enemy is 50 seconds
* this effect scales of enemy speed so make sure not to use it when enemy is stunned or slowed
==Selling==
This unit cannot be sold.

==Trivia==
*This is the very first {{Rarity|Secret}} unit, as he is released upon the game's released. He was followed by [[Fire Fist]] on Update 1.
*This is the only {{Rarity|Secret}} unit that is summonable and the first one that doesn't start out as a {{Rarity|Mythic}}.
